convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'Elliott_Wave_Oscillator' custom indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Custom indicator and non-standard smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, etc.) have no Python equivalents without manual reimplementation.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA starts trading

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: when short entry signal fires, long positions are closed (if BuyPosClose=true); when long entry signal fires, short positions are closed (if SellPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (MM interpreted as lot), FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=MM as fraction of margin/balance for position sizing

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic: When EWO[1]<EWO[2] (oscillator declining on previous bar) AND EWO[0]>EWO[1] (oscillator turning up on current bar) → long signal (momentum reversal from down to up). When EWO[1]>EWO[2] (oscillator rising on previous bar) AND EWO[0]<EWO[1] (oscillator turning down on current bar) → short signal. Signal bar parameter (default=1) controls which bar is used for signal detection; when SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick instead of only on new bars. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that independently enable/disable each trade action. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are passed to trade functions for execution timing. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: The Elliott Wave Oscillator custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It computes the difference between two smoothed price series (fast MA minus slow MA). The smoothing methods include non-standard algorithms (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which have no pandas/numpy equivalents - these require manual algorithm porting. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions with margin-based lot calculation which must also be reimplemented. The EWO itself is conceptually simple (difference of two MAs), so if converted to use standard SMA/EMA instead of JJMA/custom methods, difficulty drops to medium. Signal logic is straightforward: detect oscillator direction change (peak/trough reversal) on completed bars.
